messages:
marcus: Heads up — Bluecrest Health POC is blocked from go/no-go by two things: legal wants a completed security questionnaire + KMS BYO attestation, and the customer is pushing for a throughput SLA for 99th pct token latency. Need an internal quick sync to triage before tomorrow's exec call. :alarm_clock:
alyssa: On the KMS BYO side, their ask is to bring their AWS CMK into our Dedicated env? They specifically want CMEK for model inputs/outputs. That's doable but we need an ops runbook and an explicit network path. :thinking_face:
priya: They're asking for a 30% pilot discount if we commit to the SLA. Sales is ok to propose a limited SLA for the POC window only, but need ops + legal signoff first. Also they want written confirmation on data residency for logs.
nate: For throughput — can we promise a 99th pct <= 500ms for 4k token requests? Current Dedicated profile with q4 quantized model hits ~650ms at peak. We could propose an autoscale config and a fallback model variant at lower tokens. Sample config: ```autoscale: min_replicas:2 max_replicas:8 cpu_target:70% burst:enabled model_variant:lowlat-8bit```
dana-legal: @marcus please run the standard security questionnaire (we need the completed PDF) and attach KMS attestation (customer-signed) + our BYO KMS checklist. We can provide a conditional attestation template but legal needs the customer's SOC2/ISO docs referenced.
marcus: Copy. I'll ping Bluecrest for SOC2 scan and send them the BYO KMS checklist. Priya — can you prep a pricing note that frames the SLA as pilot-only and includes credit banding?
priya: On it. Draft will include: 30% pilot credit, SLA scoped to non-production POC, and credits refundable only if we miss three consecutive SLO windows. Will post by 12:30p PT. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
alyssa: Ops question — if we enable BYO CMK, do we need a peered VPC path or can we use a transient KMS proxy? Nate, thoughts?
nate: Need VPC peering + restricted egress to customer KMS endpoint for key ops. Proxy adds latency and cert complexity. Ops prefers peering. I'll sketch network diagram and minimal runbook by EOD.
marcus: Great. Action items: 1) dana-legal -> list of docs + template (dana-legal) 2) nate -> network runbook + latency mitigation notes 3) priya -> pricing terms + exec one-pager 4) alyssa -> deploy config suggestions (model_variant + autoscale). I'll coordinate the pre-brief for tomorrow's 9am ET exec touchpoint.
deploy-bot: Deployment checklist created: ticket #S-1209 (Bluecrest POC) assigned to alyssa, nate. ETA 2024-05-14 18:00Z.
dana-legal: Uploaded initial questionnaire template and BYO-KMS terms draft to the share doc. marcus, please request the customer's SOC2 AICPA report and their KMS attestation form.
marcus: Requested SOC2 link from the customer — they said they'll share within 2 business days. If they can't share, legal recommended a temporary control: extra logging + retention hold.
priya: Noted. I'll soften pricing ask in the exec note to keep flexibility. If legal needs more time, we offer a conditional POC extension instead of immediate sign-off.
alyssa: I'll try a canary deploy with lowlat-8bit + relax token window to keep P95 low and report numbers in the pre-brief.
nate: Sketch uploaded: /shared/ops/bluecrest-network-sketch.png — includes peering steps and expected latency numbers.
marcus: Thanks team. We'll reconvene at 8:30am ET for the pre-brief. Please flag any blockers in this thread before then. :white_check_mark:
